scope: Owned synchronous and opt-in asynchronous MCP protocol behavior, with the complete in-repository tool schema registry.

src/mcp/mcp_protocol.c: append_initialize / append_discover / request_is_modern / validate_modern_envelope -> ProtocolSession and version/envelope dispatch
append_capabilities / append_response_suffix / append_async_payload -> capabilities, metadata envelope merge, and original ID preservation
append_tool_call / append_resource_read / append_task_method -> synchronous and asynchronous dispatch
src/mcp/mcp_protocol_async.c: mcp_protocol_async_task_id -> bounded decoded task ID validation within Tasks dispatch

behavior_and_tests.protocol: Legacy 2025-11-25 initialization and initialized notification, current 2026-07-28 discovery and per-request metadata enforcement, repeated initialize rejection, session reset, unknown methods, notification suppression, and 120-request/60-second session window with -32000 limit error.
behavior_and_tests.discovery: Tools/resources/prompts capability listings and resource/prompt reads; current Tasks capability appears only when opted-in backend reports readiness.
behavior_and_tests.schemas: All 42 C-owned schemas are represented in the Rust registry; required/unknown/type checks, native loop enum, template attribute maps, bounded transaction length, and list serialization are covered.
behavior_and_tests.sync_async: Async UNHANDLED falls through to sync backend; when sync content_json is empty, both success and error fallback texts are emitted as one-element content arrays containing a text block and verified after parsing. Legacy DEFERRED emits no response; current DEFERRED errors; legacy notifications/cancelled invokes request cancellation without a response.
behavior_and_tests.tasks: Negotiated create returns flat task metadata; get returns detailed task state; cancel accepts the empty complete ACK; completion with result.isError remains a successful JSON-RPC result; a failed task state is emitted inside JSON-RPC result with its task error, while AsyncDisposition::Error emits a top-level JSON-RPC error; foreign/unavailable task errors remain JSON-RPC errors. No experimental Tasks methods or Tasks progress notifications are added.
behavior_and_tests.validation: Async error/result/create/get/cancel payload shapes, content block variants and tokenizer token bound, 2 MiB payload bound, task timestamps/status/TTL/poll interval, task ID NUL/size, cancel ACK exact fields, and legacy progress token/range/monotonicity/message/buffer rollback are exercised.
behavior_and_tests.envelopes: Tests parse every emitted response and assert jsonrpc/result-or-error shape plus byte-identical request ID token; current async metadata merge retains backend metadata and overrides backend serverInfo with Vexel identity. Malformed async JSON is rejected as -32603.

protocol_errors.-32601: unknown method or unavailable/unnegotiated Tasks method
protocol_errors.-32602: invalid tool/resource parameters or missing/invalid taskId
protocol_errors.-32603: failed/deferred current async operation, malformed async backend JSON, or oversized async response
protocol_errors.-32000: more than 120 requests inside the current 60-second session window
protocol_errors.-32002: request before initialization and missing resource
protocol_errors.-32021: Tasks capability not negotiated for this request
protocol_errors.tool_result: Tool schema/argument failures remain tool results with isError:true; unknown tool uses structured error code unknown_tool, while other validation failures use invalid_arguments.

api_adaptations: Former void-pointer callback tables become safe ProtocolBackend and AsyncBackend traits with borrowed JsonDocument views and owned Vec payloads; applications implement these traits in a later integration order.
C output buffers become bounded JsonBuffer instances; returned payloads are copied with fallible reservation, without unsafe code or a C shim.
The C version string field is represented by a private protocol-version enum and exposed read-only as a static string; session reset clears negotiation and rate state.
Rust AsyncBackend has required methods rather than nullable callback slots; tasks_available is the opt-in readiness bit, and the sync-only handle uses an internal unavailable backend.
The progress helper accepts an owned raw token byte slice and mutable prior counter; it constructs output locally and advances prior progress only after a successful append.
not_claimed: No application broker, socket transport, macOS service, or whole-app integration is included.
The C callback contract could emit malformed synchronous structured/content/resource JSON; this order preserves its raw payload contract, while the focused fake backends provide valid JSON.
